item.title: Series of cracks and holes in pavement near 32 Clifton Avenue, N3, 24th July
item.description:
These deep holes and cracks create an unstable pavement surface. They have been present for approximately six months, despite having been reported to the council several months ago. As the damage has been left to get worse, pedestrians, particularly children and the elderly, are at increased risk of stumbling and falling when trying to use the pavement. Many pedestrians are now having to walk in the road to avoid the area in question.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Clifton Avenue, Church End, Greater London
